note: Literature confirms STISS features mild distal and preaxial digital malformations (e.g. preaxial hand abnormalities, polydactyly, brachydactyly) rather than severe limb reduction defects.

evidence.text: The study confirmed preaxial hand abnormalities as an expanding clinical feature in individuals with Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: In addition to previously reported DD/ID, speech delay, cardiac and renal anomalies, we also confirmed preaxial hand abnormalities as a feature of this syndrome.

evidence.text: PSMD12 alterations causing Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome are associated with distal digital anomalies such as brachydactyly, polydactyly, or camptodactyly.
